spec: RFC 7515 compact serialization, as a token and a DPoP proof (RFC 9449): three non-empty ASCII segments joined by '.', each canonical unpadded base64url (one spelling per byte string); the header and the claims each one JSON object the strict reader admits. A member is used only in the JSON type its specification gives: alg, typ, kid, iss, sub, client_id, azp, jti, htm, htu, ath are strings; iat, exp, nbf are exact integers (integer.json); aud is a string or a list; cnf, act and jwk are objects; x5c is a list of one string. A member in another type names nothing: it is never turned into text.
derived: each member of each document replaced by each of otherTypes, signed again
each object given each of ownMembers as an extra member, signed again
